messages:
mona: FYI — customer Nora reports they lost console access after enabling SSO + SCIM. Getting 403 Permission denied when trying to open project settings. Ticket SUP-123456.

nora (customer): I click the project > Settings and immediately see '403 Permission denied'. I was org admin before the Okta migration. Screenshot: https://files.vendorco.com/shot.png

mona: Steps they did: enable SSO (Okta) yesterday, SCIM push completed ~04:12 UTC. They say several users who were admins are now missing admin roles.

sam (idp): @mona can you paste the SCIM event log snippet? specifically looking for group remove/add events.

nora (customer): SCIM log (excerpt):
```
2026-03-05T04:12:22Z SCIM event: member:remove user:nora@vendorco.com reason: group_membership_change
2026-03-05T04:12:22Z SCIM event: group:update okta:project-admin -> removed
```

raj (eng): This matches cases where group->role mapping didn't include a mapping for our org_admin role. SCIM will unset the role if it can't map the incoming group. Common when IdP group names change during an Okta migration.

devex: Quick repro I used locally:
1) create org, invite user A, give org_admin.
2) enable SCIM and map only a 'viewer' group.
3) push SCIM -> user A loses org_admin and gets viewer or null.

CLI repro with API call (resulting 403):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \\
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/0x9f3/projects/42/members
# -> 403 {"error":"permission_denied","reason":"missing_role:project.viewer"}
```

ops-bot: role-sync job completed 2026-03-05T04:12:25Z; summary: 12 users updated, 2 roles removed.

mona: @raj we need to restore Nora's org_admin asap — customer blocked from deployments. They can't run infra workflows.

raj: Options:
- Preferred: IdP admin (Okta) fix group->role mapping to include a group mapped to redwood:org_admin, then trigger SCIM push.
- If IdP admin unavailable: support can perform a temporary manual grant of org_admin (requires ops approval + audit ticket).
- Long term: add UI guard to warn before removing last org admin during SCIM sync.

mona: Customer says IdP admin is OOO today. Any emergency path?

ops-bot: audit: request SUP-123456 created by mona at 2026-03-05T05:45:00Z. Pending ops approval.

raj: I can perform the manual grant once ops approves. I will record the change and add an expiry tag.

mona: Ops approved (email thread). Please proceed.

raj: Performed manual role grant: PUT /v1/orgs/0x9f3/members/nora/roles -> ["org_admin"] (internal admin API). Audit recorded. Nora can you confirm access?

nora (customer): Confirmed! I can open Settings and re-run deployments. Thank you. :raised_hands:

devex: Action items captured:
- raj: create follow-up ticket to add a pre-sync warning if SCIM mappings would remove the last org_admin.
- sam: update SSO/SCIM docs with recovery steps (how to re-map groups + run an immediate mapping apply).
- support: add runbook 'scim-removes-last-admin' with CLI commands and audit checks.

raj: I'll also add a simple health check that fires if an org has zero org_admins after a sync — alert to support on-call.

mona: Closing loop with customer and adding notes to SUP-123456. Marking this thread resolved once docs/runbook updates are merged. :white_check_mark:
